title: Pseudo-Pythagorean ethical and political treatises (Thesleff corpus): Pseudo-Archytas, Pseudo-Metopus, Pseudo-Theages, Pseudo-Euryphamus, Pseudo-Hippodamus, Callicratidas; RU «Псевдопифагорейские трактаты»
author: Pseudonymous 'Pythagoreans'
size: Thesleff 1965 about 250 pp.; ethical-political prose est. 25–30k words
edition: Thesleff 1965 (copyrighted). Public domain: Stobaeus, ed. Wachsmuth–Hense (archive.org adw8682) and Mullach, FPG (archive.org).
ru_evidence: Russian exists only for Timaeus Locrus (ΣΧΟΛΗ 2013), the Pythagorean women's letters (ΣΧΟΛΗ 2018) and the Stobaeus IV.7 kingship texts (2018). The ethical treatises: none found.
en_evidence: Thesleff gives the Greek only. No complete modern English found (Open Library). Old Taylor versions are reportedly in Guthrie's Pythagorean Sourcebook (not verified here).
other_translations: Italian: B. Centrone, Pseudopythagorica ethica (Bibliopolis 1990), per Open Library.
value: Hellenistic pseudepigrapha that shaped Middle Platonism, Philo and Neoplatonism: virtue, happiness, law, the household. Little known even to specialists; important for historians of ethics, political thought and the Pythagorean tradition.
ai_feasibility: Medium. Artificial Doric and textual corruption; the units are short. Centrone's Italian helps with checking.
pilot_unit: Centrone set: Pseudo-Archytas On the Good and Happy Man, Pseudo-Metopus and Pseudo-Theages On Virtue, Pseudo-Euryphamus, Pseudo-Hippodamus On Happiness; about 8k words (estimate).
